  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  DESIGN REVIEW COMMITTEE
  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 07, 2022 AT 6:00 PM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Design
Review Committee with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 1st and 3rd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the
Community Development Department at (626) 300­0713 or at
Planning@cityofsanmarino.org at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the Design Review Committee may teleconference into the meeting without
noticing each teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public
meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID 19)
As a precaution to protect staff, our constituents, and appointed officials, the City is
following the State and County Health Department's current Health Officer recommendation
to prevent and reduce transmission of COVID­19 by holding meetings via teleconference.

  Board Chair during public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the
  interest of time.
  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Members of the public participating via the Zoom applications may
  select the raise hand function prior to the close of public comment on an item.

How to participate in the meeting from home:
  1. Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/5719496876
  Meeting ID: 571 949 6876
  2. Submit Public Comments via email:
  Email: Planning@cityofsanmarino.org

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION please contact the Planning Division at (626) 300­0713. A
copy of the staff reports under review at this Design Review Committee meeting will be
available for public review by the end of the day December, 1, 2022 on the City’s website at:
www.cityofsanmarino.org.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Member Raymond Cheng, Member Rick Chou, Member Joyce Gatsoulis­Batnij, Vice Chair

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.cityofsanmarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review
Committee by submitting a public comment request and giving it to the Community Services
Director prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the Design Review
Committee on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the Design
Review Commission may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves the right to place limits on duration

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Design Review

of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

1.  CONSIDERATION OF DENIAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  22­56 AT 865 CANTERBURY ROAD FOR THE INSTALLATION OF
  CERTAINTEED PRESIDENTIAL SHAKE TL COMPOSITION SHINGLES
  IN THE COUNTRY GRAY COLOR (LUO)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee deny the project.

2.  CONSIDERATION OF DENIAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  22­62 AT 1335 BELHAVEN ROAD FOR THE INSTALLATION OF
  CERTAINTEED PRESIDENTIAL SHAKE TL COMPOSITION SHINGLES
  IN THE SHADOW GRAY COLOR (LIU)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee deny the project.

3.  CONSIDERATION OF DENIAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. 22­60
  AT 2280 MELVILLE DRIVE FOR THE REPLACEMENT OF EXISTING
  NATURAL WOOD SHAKE ROOF TO CERTAINTEED PRESIDENTIAL TL
  COMPOSITION SHINGLE IN AUTUMN BLEND COLOR. (CHAN)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee deny the project.

4.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  22­65 AT 1445 LORAIN ROAD FOR THE REPLACEMENT OF THE
  EXISTING WOOD SHAKE ROOF WITH CERTAINTEED PRESIDENTIAL
  SHAKE TL IN THE SHADOW GRAY COLOR.(NELSON)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee:​1 . Determine that based on the
  whole of the administrative record, the proposed roofing project is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Section 15301, Class I (Existing facilities), and
  that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical
  exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies;​2 . Find that the
  proposed project is compatible with the Legal Neighborhood and with the existing
  structure itself; and​3. Approve the project with CertaintTeed Presidential Shake TL
  composition shingle roofing material in the Shadow Gray color or the Autumn Blend
  color.

  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f

6.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  22­58 AT 2900 MONTEREY ROAD TO REPLACE ONE EXISTING
  WOOD WINDOW WITH A SMALLER WOOD WINDOW WHICH IS
  VISIBLE FROM THE PUBLIC STREET VIEW (JETVIROJ)​
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee:​1 . Determine that based on the
  whole of the administrative record, that the proposed addition is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Article 19, Section 15302, Class 1, and that
  there is no substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical
  exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies. ​2 . Find that the
  proposed project is compatible with the legal neighborhood and with the existing
  structure itself; and​3. Approve the project.

7.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO. DR
  22­57 AT 2283 HUNTINGTON DRIVE FOR A NEW WALL SIGN TO AN
  EXISTING COMMERCIAL SPACE. (KT ENTERPRISE LLC)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee: 1. Determine that the proposed
  installation of a new wall sign on an existing commercial building are exempt from the
  Californa Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines
  Section 15301 (g); 2. Find that the proposed signage is compatible with signage
  found on adjacent commercial structures; and 3. Approve the project as proposed.

8.  CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL FOR DESIGN REVIEW CASE NO DR
  22­04 AT 1850 SOUTH EUCLID AVENUE TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST
  AND SECOND­STORY ADDITION TO THE REAR OF THE EXISTING
  HOME (MCEWEN)
  Recommendation: B a s e d o n t h e i n f o r m a t i o n s u b m i t t e d t o t h e r e c o r d , s t a f f
  recommends that the Design Review Committee 1) determine that based on the
  whole of the administrative record, that the proposed addition is exempt from CEQA
  pursuant to State CEQA Guidelines, Article 19, Sections 15331, and there is no
  substantial evidence demonstrating an exception to the categorical exemption
  pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies; and 2) find that the proposed
  project is compatible with the legal neighborhood and with the existing structure
  itself; and 3) approve the project.
